tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Read current published guide and transfer service information directly from Belgium Art WordPress pages. Preserve the published terms and qualifications. Availability is not connected. No booking or submission.

tools.name: prepare_tour_request
tools.description: Prepare an unsent Telegram draft for an individual guided tour in Belgium. The client must review and manually send it; Felix then confirms terms. Unknown optional details must be omitted. No booking, payment or notification.

tools.name: prepare_transfer_request
tools.description: Prepare an unsent Telegram draft for a transfer. Origin and destination are required. Times are local to the respective departure points. Other details may be discussed later. The client must review and manually send; Felix confirms availability and price. No submission.
